standard: Why Choose the KCS-230B for Your Production Line?

High-Speed Mass Production: Engineered specifically for rapid, continuous cut-offs of solid steel bars and heavy-walled tubes, maximizing daily workshop throughput and eliminating department bottlenecks.

Uncompromised Cutting Precision: Equipped with an advanced PLC/CNC control framework and ultra-rigid smart feeding systems to ensure dead-straight cuts, strict geometric tolerances, and smooth surface finishes.

Exceptional Blade Cost-Efficiency: The heavy-duty structural frame absorbs cutting harmonics and eliminates micro-vibrations, drastically reducing TCT or carbide cold saw blade wear and lowering your long-term cost-per-cut.

The KCS-230B CNC circular saw machine represents the cutting edge of industrial metal fabrication technology. Designed to withstand the rigors of heavy multi-shift mass production, this high-performance sawing center delivers a synchronized synergy of speed and accuracy that conventional band saws cannot match when handling medium to large diameter solid carbon steels and alloy stocks.

At the heart of the KCS-230B is its vibration-dampening cast iron base and rigid linear guide pathways. By absorbing the micro-harmonics generated during high-speed carbide-tipped blade penetration, the machine ensures a mirrored, burr-free surface finish on the cut workpiece. This extreme precision frequently eliminates the need for secondary face-grinding, deburring, or facing operations, saving your workshop substantial labor hours.

The fully integrated CNC smart control system allows operators to pre-program variable feed rates, optimal cutting speeds, and complex multi-batch tasks via an intuitive touch-screen interface. Paired with a robust servo-driven shuttle feeding vise, the KCS-230B continuously indexes heavy steel bundles with zero manual positioning errors, transforming your raw material cutoff department into a highly profitable, autonomous asset.
Q: What specific material types can the KCS-230B CNC circular saw machine process?
A: The KCS-230B is highly optimized for high-speed cutting of carbon steel, alloy steel, bearing steel, tool steel, and structural heavy-walled seamless tubes.
Q: How does the KCS-230B achieve its high accuracy tolerances?

A: Accuracy is achieved through a rigid, heavily weighted cast frame combined with an AC servo motor-driven feeding mechanism and precision-ground ball screws, which clamp and index material within strict millimeter tolerances.
Q: Is the operator control interface user-friendly for non-technical workers?

A: Yes, the machine features an intuitive, multi-language CNC touch-screen HMI. Operators can easily configure cut lengths, batch quantities, and monitor machine diagnostics within minutes of basic training.
Q: What type of cutting blades does this machine utilize?
A: It is designed to work with premium TCT (Tungsten Carbide Tipped) or cermet-tipped circular saw blades, allowing for aggressive penetration speeds and long tool life.

Don’t let an outdated or underpowered cutoff saw dictate the efficiency of your modern manufacturing floor. The KCS-230B is engineered to scale your output, lower your raw material scrap rates, and protect your downstream processing profitability.

models.description: The KCS-70C is a high-speed, fully automatic CNC circular cold sawing machine engineered specifically for rapid, high-precision cutoff of solid metal bars, tubes, and structural shapes up to φ70mm in diameter. Combining a ultra-rigid cast-iron bed with advanced dual AC servo motor drives for material feeding and downfeed cutting, the KCS-70C achieves exceptional linear dimensional accuracy within ±0.05mm , producing clean, mirror-like cut faces with zero burrs.
intro: The KCS-70C is a high-speed, fully automatic CNC circular cold sawing machine engineered specifically for rapid, high-precision cutoff of solid metal bars, tubes, and structural shapes up to φ70mm in diameter. Combining a ultra-rigid cast-iron bed with advanced dual AC servo motor drives for material feeding and downfeed cutting, the KCS-70C achieves exceptional linear dimensional accuracy within ±0.05mm , producing clean, mirror-like cut faces with zero burrs.

Designed as a complete turnkey automation solution, the KCS-70C executes continuous auto-loading, auto-feeding, auto-cutting, and auto-unloading . For standard φ50mm mild steel solid bars (20mm cutoff length), cutting takes just 3.7 seconds per piece (4.8s total cycle time) , allowing a single machine unit to deliver approximately 6,000 finished pieces per 8-hour shift . With its intelligent PLC interface, a single operator can easily monitor up to 4 KCS-70C machine units simultaneously .
